title: Happy with my purchase.
text: Happy with my purchase.. I bought 3 of these pillow cases for 3 girls in my family, ranging in age from 4 to 12 years old.  I also purchased pillows for the cases, that were one size larger than the cases, as suggested by another purchaser in a review.  As mentioned in the comments, I did have to do a bit of cramming to get the pillow into the case, but it did give me a fuller, firmer pillow and I was glad I listened to that comment.  I think they would have been kind of flat, had I used the same size.  I didn't buy these for their decorative value.  I gave the pillows to the girls as we were waiting for dinner to be served at a family gathering.  We hardly saw the girls the rest of the night because they were having so much fun "writing" on the pillows and figuring different things they could draw/write.  Everyone who saw the pillows thought they were a great gift and I saw, first hand, how much they were enjoyed. I don't know how long it will be before the sequins fall off because the threads holding them on finally break after being pushed around and around, but so far so good.  They seem to be well made with an "invisible" zipper and "velvet" backing.  I'd buy them again.
